versos.grego: Διοδεύσαντες δὲ τὴν Ἀμφίπολιν καὶ τὴν Ἀπολλωνίαν ἦλθον εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην, ὅπου ἦν συναγωγὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

controles.web: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
controles.kjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
controles.livre: E viajando por Anfípolis e Apolônia, vieram a Tessalônica, onde havia uma sinagoga de judeus.

versos.grego: κατὰ δὲ τὸ εἰωθὸς τῷ Παύλῳ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐπὶ σάββατα τρία διελέξατο αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν γραφῶν,

controles.web: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
controles.kjv: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
controles.livre: E Paulo, como era de seu costume, entrou a eles, e por três sábados argumentava com eles pelas Escrituras.

versos.grego: διανοίγων καὶ παρατιθέμενος ὅτι τὸν Χριστὸν ἔδει παθεῖν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός, ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ὃν ἐγὼ καταγγέλλω ὑμῖν.

controles.web: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
controles.kjv: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
controles.livre: Declarando -as ,e propondo -lhes ,que era necessário que o Cristo morresse, e ressuscitasse dos mortos; e que ( dizia ele ) este Jesus é o Cristo, a quem eu vos anuncio.

versos.grego: καί τινες ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐπείσθησαν καὶ προσεκληρώθησαν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ τῷ Σιλᾷ, τῶν τε σεβομένων Ἑλλήνων πλῆθος πολὺ, γυναικῶν τε τῶν πρώτων οὐκ ὀλίγαι.

controles.web: Some of them were persuaded, and joined Paul and Silas, of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
controles.kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
controles.livre: E alguns deles creram, e se ajuntaram a Paulo e Silas; e dos gregos devotos grande multidão; e não poucas das mulheres principais.

versos.grego: Ζηλώσαντες δὲ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ προσλαβόμενοι τῶν ἀγοραίων ἄνδρας τινὰς πονηροὺς καὶ ὀχλοποιήσαντες ἐθορύβουν τὴν πόλιν, καὶ ἐπιστάντες τῇ οἰκίᾳ Ἰάσονος ἐζήτουν αὐτοὺς προαγαγεῖν εἰς τὸν δῆμον·

controles.web: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace, and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
controles.kjv: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
controles.livre: Mas os judeus incrédulos, movidos de inveja, tomaram consigo alguns homens malignos dos mercados, e juntando uma multidão, tumultuaram a cidade; e atacando a casa de Jasão, procuravam trazê-los ao povo.

versos.grego: μὴ εὑρόντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔσυρον Ἰάσονα καί τινας ἀδελφοὺς ἐπὶ τοὺς πολιτάρχας, βοῶντες ὅτι Οἱ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἀναστατώσαντες οὗτοι καὶ ἐνθάδε πάρεισιν,

controles.web: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers  before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
controles.kjv: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
controles.livre: E não os achando, puxaram a Jasão, e a alguns irmãos às maiores autoridades da cidade, clamando: Estes que tem perturbado ao mundo também vieram até aqui.

versos.grego: οὓς ὑποδέδεκται Ἰάσων· καὶ οὗτοι πάντες ἀπέναντι τῶν δογμάτων Καίσαρος πράσσουσιν, βασιλέα ἕτερον λέγοντες εἶναι Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
controles.kjv: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
controles.livre: Aos quais Jasão tem recolhido, e todos estes fazem contra as ordens de César, dizendo que há outro rei, chamado Jesus.

versos.grego: ἐτάραξαν δὲ τὸν ὄχλον καὶ τοὺς πολιτάρχας ἀκούοντας ταῦτα,

controles.web: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
controles.kjv: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
controles.livre: E eles tumultuaram a multidão, e às autoridades da cidade, que ouviam estas coisas.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβόντες τὸ ἱκανὸν παρὰ τοῦ Ἰάσονος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν ἀπέλυσαν αὐτούς.

controles.web: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
controles.kjv: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
controles.livre: Mas tendo recebido fiança de Jasão e dos demais, eles os soltaram.

versos.grego: Οἱ δὲ ἀδελφοὶ εὐθέως διὰ νυκτὸς ἐξέπεμψαν τόν τε Παῦλον καὶ τὸν Σιλᾶν εἰς Βέροιαν, οἵτινες παραγενόμενοι εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἀπῄεσαν·

controles.web: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
controles.kjv: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
controles.livre: E logo os irmãos enviaram de noite a Paulo e a Silas até Bereia; os quais, ao chegarem lá, foram à sinagoga dos judeus.

versos.grego: οὗτοι δὲ ἦσαν εὐγενέστεροι τῶν ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ, οἵτινες ἐδέξαντο τὸν λόγον μετὰ πάσης προθυμίας, τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀνακρίνοντες τὰς γραφὰς εἰ ἔχοι ταῦτα οὕτως.

controles.web: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of the mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
controles.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
controles.livre: E estes foram mais nobres do que os que estavam em Tessalônica, porque os quais receberam a palavra com toda boa vontade, examinando a cada dia as escrituras, para ver se estas coisas eram assim.

versos.grego: πολλοὶ μὲν οὖν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐπίστευσαν, καὶ τῶν Ἑλληνίδων γυναικῶν τῶν εὐσχημόνων καὶ ἀνδρῶν οὐκ ὀλίγοι.

controles.web: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
controles.kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
controles.livre: Portanto muitos deles realmente creram, e das mulheres gregas honradas; e dos homens, não poucos.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Θεσσαλονίκης Ἰουδαῖοι ὅτι καὶ ἐν τῇ Βεροίᾳ κατηγγέλη ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἦλθον κἀκεῖ σαλεύοντες καὶ ταράσσοντες τοὺς ὄχλους.

controles.web: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
controles.kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
controles.livre: Mas quando os judeus de Tessalônica souberam que também em Bereia a palavra de Deus era anunciada por Paulo, vieram também para lá, e incitaram as multidões.

versos.grego: εὐθέως δὲ τότε τὸν Παῦλον ἐξαπέστειλαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πορεύεσθαι ἕως ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν· ὑπέμεινάν τε ὅ τε Σιλᾶς καὶ ὁ Τιμόθεος ἐκεῖ.

controles.web: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
controles.kjv: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
controles.livre: Mas então no mesmo instante os irmãos despediram a Paulo, para que fosse ao mar; mas Silas e Timóteo continuaram ali.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ καθιστάνοντες τὸν Παῦλον ἤγαγον ἕως Ἀθηνῶν, καὶ λαβόντες ἐντολὴν πρὸς τὸν Σιλᾶν καὶ τὸν Τιμόθεον ἵνα ὡς τάχιστα ἔλθωσιν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐξῄεσαν.

controles.web: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
controles.kjv: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
controles.livre: E os que conduziram a Paulo, levaram-no até Atenas; e tendo recebido ordem para Silas e Timóteo, para que viessem a ele o mais rápido que pudessem ,eles foram embora.

versos.grego: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς Ἀθήναις ἐκδεχομένου αὐτοὺς τοῦ Παύλου, παρωξύνετο τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ θεωροῦντος κατείδωλον οὖσαν τὴν πόλιν.

controles.web: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
controles.kjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
controles.livre: E enquanto Paulo os esperava em Atenas, seu espírito se incomodava dentro dele, ao ver a cidade tão dedicada à idolatria.

versos.grego: διελέγετο μὲν οὖν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις καὶ τοῖς σεβομένοις καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ κατὰ πᾶσαν ἡμέραν πρὸς τοὺς παρατυγχάνοντας.

controles.web: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
controles.kjv: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
controles.livre: Então ele disputava muito na sinagoga, com os judeus, e com os religiosos; e no mercado a cada dia, com os que vinham até ele .

versos.grego: τινὲς δὲ καὶ τῶν Ἐπικουρίων καὶ Στοϊκῶν φιλοσόφων συνέβαλλον αὐτῷ, καί τινες ἔλεγον Τί ἂν θέλοι ὁ σπερμολόγος οὗτος λέγειν; οἱ δέ· Ξένων δαιμονίων δοκεῖ καταγγελεὺς εἶναι· ὅτι τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ τὴν ἀνάστασιν εὐηγγελίζετο.

controles.web: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?”   Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
controles.kjv: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
controles.livre: E alguns dos filósofos epicureus e estoicos discutiam com ele; e uns diziam: O que quer dizer este tagarela?E outros: Parece que ele é pregador de deuses estranhos.Porque ele lhes anunciava o Evangelho de Jesus e a ressurreição.

versos.grego: ἐπιλαβόμενοί δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἄρειον πάγον ἤγαγον, λέγοντες Δυνάμεθα γνῶναι τίς ἡ καινὴ αὕτη ἡ ὑπὸ σοῦ λαλουμένη διδαχή;

controles.web: They took hold of him, and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by you?
controles.kjv: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
controles.livre: E tomando-o, trouxeram -no ao areópago, dizendo: Podemos nós saber que doutrina nova é esta que tu falas?

versos.grego: ξενίζοντα γάρ τινα εἰσφέρεις εἰς τὰς ἀκοὰς ἡμῶν· βουλόμεθα οὖν γνῶναι τίνα θέλει ταῦτα εἶναι.

controles.web: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
controles.kjv: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
controles.livre: Porque tu trazes coisas estranhas aos nossos ouvidos; então queremos saber o que isto quer dizer.

versos.grego: Ἀθηναῖοι δὲ πάντες καὶ οἱ ἐπιδημοῦντες ξένοι εἰς οὐδὲν ἕτερον ηὐκαίρουν ἢ λέγειν τι ἢ ἀκούειν τι καινότερον.

controles.web: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
controles.kjv: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
controles.livre: (E todos os atenienses e visitantes estrangeiros não se ocupavam de nenhuma outra coisa, a não ser em dizer e ouvir alguma novidade).

versos.grego: Σταθεὶς δὲ Παῦλος ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Ἀρείου Πάγου ἔφη Ἄνδρες Ἀθηναῖοι, κατὰ πάντα ὡς δεισιδαιμονεστέρους ὑμᾶς θεωρῶ.

controles.web: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus, and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
controles.kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
controles.livre: E Paulo, estando no meio do areópago, disse: Homens atenienses, eu vejo em tudo como vós sois muito religiosos;

versos.grego: διερχόμενος γὰρ καὶ ἀναθεωρῶν τὰ σεβάσματα ὑμῶν εὗρον καὶ βωμὸν ἐν ᾧ ἐπεγέγραπτο ΑΓΝΩΣΤΩ ΘΕΩ. ὃ οὖν ἀγνοοῦντες εὐσεβεῖτε, τοῦτο ἐγὼ καταγγέλλω ὑμῖν.

controles.web: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, this I announce to you.
controles.kjv: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
controles.livre: Porque enquanto eu passava pela cidade e via vossos santuários, achei também um altar, em que estava escrito: AO DEUS DESCONHECIDO. Este a quem vós prestais devoção sem conhecer, este é o que eu vos anuncio;

versos.grego: ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας τὸν κόσμον καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ, οὗτος οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς ὑπάρχων Κύριος οὐκ ἐν χειροποιήτοις ναοῖς κατοικεῖ,

controles.web: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands,
controles.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
controles.livre: O Deus que fez o mundo, e todas as coisas que nele há ; este, sendo Senhor do céu e da terra, não habita em tempos feitos por mãos.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ ὑπὸ χειρῶν ἀνθρωπίνων θεραπεύεται προσδεόμενός τινος, αὐτὸς διδοὺς πᾶσι ζωὴν καὶ πνοὴν καὶ τὰ πάντα·

controles.web: neither is he served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things.
controles.kjv: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
controles.livre: E nem também é servido por mãos humanas; como que necessitasse de alguma coisa; porque ele é que dá a todos vida, respiração, e todas as coisas;

versos.grego: ἐποίησέν τε ἐξ ἑνὸς πᾶν ἔθνος ἀνθρώπων κατοικεῖν ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τῆς γῆς, ὁρίσας προστεταγμένους καιροὺς καὶ τὰς ὁροθεσίας τῆς κατοικίας αὐτῶν,

controles.web: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons, and the boundaries of their dwellings,
controles.kjv: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
controles.livre: E de um sangue ele fez toda nação humana, para habitarem sobre a face da terra, determinando os tempos desde antes ordenados, e o limites da morada deles ;

versos.grego: ζητεῖν τὸν Θεὸν, εἰ ἄρα γε ψηλαφήσειαν αὐτὸν καὶ εὕροιεν, καί γε οὐ μακρὰν ἀπὸ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου ἡμῶν ὑπάρχοντα.

controles.web: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
controles.kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
controles.livre: Para que buscassem ao Senhor, se talvez pudessem apalpá-lo e encontrá-lo,apesar dele não estar longe de cada um de nós.

versos.grego: ἐν αὐτῷ γὰρ ζῶμεν καὶ κινούμεθα καὶ ἐσμέν, ὡς καί τινες τῶν καθ’ ὑμᾶς ποιητῶν εἰρήκασιν Τοῦ γὰρ καὶ γένος ἐσμέν.

controles.web: ‘For in him we live, and move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
controles.kjv: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
controles.livre: Porque nele vivemos, e nos movemos, e somos; assim como também alguns de vossos poetas disseram; porque também nós somos descendência dele.

versos.grego: γένος οὖν ὑπάρχοντες τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ὀφείλομεν νομίζειν, χρυσῷ ἢ ἀργύρῳ ἢ λίθῳ, χαράγματι τέχνης καὶ ἐνθυμήσεως ἀνθρώπου, τὸ Θεῖον εἶναι ὅμοιον.

controles.web: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
controles.kjv: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.
controles.livre: Sendo então descendência de Deus, nós não devemos pensar que a divindade seja semelhante a ouro, ou a prata, ou a pedra esculpida por artifício e imaginação humana.

versos.grego: τοὺς μὲν οὖν χρόνους τῆς ἀγνοίας ὑπεριδὼν ὁ Θεὸς τὰ νῦν ἀπαγγέλλει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις πάντας πανταχοῦ μετανοεῖν,

controles.web: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
controles.kjv: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
controles.livre: Portanto Deus, tendo desconsiderado os tempos da vossa ignorância, agora anuncia a todos as pessoas, em todo lugar, para que se arrependam.

versos.grego: καθότι ἔστησεν ἡμέραν ἐν ᾗ μέλλει κρίνειν τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ, ἐν ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὥρισεν, πίστιν παρασχὼν πᾶσιν ἀναστήσας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

controles.web: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
controles.kjv: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
controles.livre: Porque ele tem estabelecido um dia em que ele julgará ao mundo em justiça por meio do homem a quem determinou; dando certeza a todos, tendo o ressuscitado dos mortos.

versos.grego: ἀκούσαντες δὲ ἀνάστασιν νεκρῶν, οἱ μὲν ἐχλεύαζον, οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἀκουσόμεθά σου περὶ τούτου καὶ πάλιν.

controles.web: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
controles.kjv: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
controles.livre: E ao ouvirem da ressurreição dos mortos, alguns zombavam; e outros diziam: Nós ouviremos sobre isto de ti na próxima vez.

versos.grego: οὕτως ὁ Παῦλος ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Thus Paul went out from among them.
controles.kjv: So Paul departed from among them.
controles.livre: E assim Paulo saiu do meio deles.

versos.grego: τινὲς δὲ ἄνδρες κολληθέντες αὐτῷ ἐπίστευσαν, ἐν οἷς καὶ Διονύσιος ὁ Ἀρεοπαγείτης καὶ γυνὴ ὀνόματι Δάμαρις καὶ ἕτεροι σὺν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: But certain men joined with him, and believed, among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
controles.kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
controles.livre: Porém, tendo chegado alguns homens até ele, creram; entre os quais estava também Dionísio o areopagita, e uma mulher de nome Dâmaris, e outros com eles.
